resource_key.description: The key under which the DynamoDB resource is registered.

aws_access_key_id_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the AWS access key ID.

aws_secret_access_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the AWS secret access key.

endpoint_url.description: Custom endpoint URL (e.g. http://localhost:8000 for DynamoDB Local).

description: Register an AWS DynamoDB resource for serverless key-value and document storage
name: Amazon DynamoDB Resource

resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.
resource_key.label: Resource Key

aws_access_key_id_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the AWS access key ID. Leave empty to use boto3's default credential chain (IAM role, ~/.aws, etc.).
aws_access_key_id_env_var.label: Aws Access Key Id Env Var

aws_secret_access_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the AWS secret access key.
aws_secret_access_key_env_var.label: Aws Secret Access Key Env Var

endpoint_url.description: Custom DynamoDB endpoint URL for LocalStack or DynamoDB Local, e.g. 'http://localhost:8000'.
endpoint_url.label: Endpoint Url
